info.name: Boudica Agents
info.summary: Build, save, and run personal Boudica agent flows.
info.description: Boudica Agents lets a Nextcloud user browse shared (admin-created) agents and build/edit/delete their own private multi-step agent flows — the same builder as the main Boudica app's agents overlay, ported to run standalone inside Nextcloud.
info.author: You
